tests.name: Shared paths aren't duplicated (exercise 8)
20 000 words, 20 000 queries
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(208)
letters = 'abcdefghij'
words = [''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(3, 12))) for _ in range(20000)]
queries = [''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(2, 9))) for _ in range(10000)] + random.sample(words, 10000)
tests.hint: Each query should only walk down the trie, not loop over every word.
